worldcombat.skill.safeguard.summary: Raises a ring of warding light over the caster and nearby allies; inside it, any status condition that arrives through the shared status route is turned away. The ward follows the caster, and anyone who leaves its reach loses the cover.
worldcombat.skill.safeguard.use.0: Block blanket burns, poison and paralysis
worldcombat.skill.safeguard.use.1: Raise the ward before the foe starts spreading conditions
worldcombat.skill.safeguard.use.2: Cover an ally about to step in
The ward covers the caster and allies within %2$s blocks for %1$s: while it holds, any status condition arriving through the shared status route is turned away.
the current cast range is %2$s blocks. It only stops status conditions, not damage or control.
Raising it takes %1$s, the recovery is %2$s and the cooldown %3$s. See the ward note for the deep/early trade-off.
worldcombat.skill.safeguard.ward.0: Early: duration x0.75, radius x0.85, motes x0.85, in exchange for -2 ticks wind-up and x0.8 cooldown — quick to raise and refresh.
worldcombat.skill.safeguard.ward.1: Deep: duration x1.25, radius x1.15, motes x1.15, at +3 ticks wind-up and x1.15 cooldown — held long and spread wide.
worldcombat.skill.safeguard.timing: Cast on yourself: after %2$s of preparation it spends %4$s PP to raise the ward; the recovery is %3$s and the cooldown %5$s from commit.
worldcombat.skill.safeguard.preference.w: Deep: duration x1.25, radius x1.15, motes x1.15, +3 ticks wind-up, x1.15 cooldown — good to hold a position and cover several allies. Early: duration x0.75, radius x0.85, motes x0.85, -2 ticks wind-up, x0.8 cooldown — good to keep the whole team covered on the move.
worldcombat.skill.safeguard.preference.a: The partner only considers raising the ward while a threat is this close; smaller keeps it for melee pressure, larger prepares from farther away.
Under pressure: only while a foe is attacking the partner or its owner, or the partner was just hurt. Anytime: raise the ward on any threat.
When on, the partner will also leave its post to raise the ward.
world_combat.move.safeguard.text.guard: The ward turns the status away
